title: Minimaxity and Admissibility of Bayesian Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2604.04673v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) offer a natural probabilistic formulation for inference in deep learning models. Despite their popularity, their optimality has received limited attention through the lens of statistical decision theory. In this paper, we study decision rules induced by deep, fully connected feedforward ReLU BNNs in the normal location model under quadratic loss. We show that, for fixed prior scales, the induced Bayes decision rule is not minimax. We then propose a hyperprior on the effective output variance of the BNN prior that yields a superharmonic square-root marginal density, establishing that the resulting decision rule is simultaneously admissible and minimax. We further extend these results from the quadratic loss setting to the predictive density estimation problem with Kullback--Leibler loss. Finally, we validate our theoretical findings numerically through simulation.

translated_title: 贝叶斯神经网络的最小最大性与容许性
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯神经网络（BNN）为深度学习模型中的推断提供了一种自然的概率化表述。尽管贝叶斯神经网络广受欢迎，但从统计决策理论的角度对其最优性的研究却十分有限。本文研究了在正态位置模型和平方损失下，由深度全连接前馈ReLU贝叶斯神经网络所诱导的决策规则。我们证明，在固定先验尺度的情况下，所诱导的贝叶斯决策规则不是最小最大的（minimax）。随后，我们在BNN先验的有效输出方差上提出一种超先验，该超先验可产生超调和的平方根边际密度，从而证明了由此得到的决策规则同时具有容许性和最小最大性。我们进一步将这些结果从平方损失设定扩展到基于Kullback-Leibler损失的预测密度估计问题。最后，我们通过数值模拟验证了这些理论发现。
tldr: 本文从统计决策理论出发，证明了固定先验尺度下深度ReLU贝叶斯神经网络诱导的贝叶斯决策规则不具有最小最大性，并通过在有效输出方差上引入超先验，构造出同时具有容许性与最小最大性的决策规则，且将结果扩展到了KL损失下的预测密度估计问题。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the Bayes decision rule induced by deep ReLU Bayesian neural networks under fixed prior scales is not minimax, and proposes a hyperprior on the effective output variance that yields a decision rule which is simultaneously admissible and minimax, with results further extended to predictive density estimation under Kullback-Leibler loss.
